sections.name: The rope
styles: a detuned resonator guitar plucked far away every few bars

sections.name: Under the bridge
styles: low strings swell slowly and recede
slide guitar answers itself from far off

sections.name: Cold water
styles: slow pulsing sub bass like a heartbeat under water

sections.name: The far bank
styles: the guitar comes up out of the water

sections.name: It's coming apart
styles: driving floor tom and rusted metal percussion

sections.name: The fever
styles: swells to a peak and falls away

sections.name: Coming to
styles: a thin high sustained tone slowly fading
one slide guitar note at the very end
a hot night in an empty small town

sections.name: Down the road
styles: brushed kick drum very far away

sections.name: The rail line
styles: bowed bass and a dusty harmonium drone

sections.name: Nobody home
styles: fingerpicked guitar returns in a lower register

sections.name: They've seen him
styles: heavy slow pulse from low toms and rusted metal hits

sections.name: Closer
styles: strings climb in semitones and never arrive

sections.name: That's it
styles: a low dying drone falling in pitch

sections.name: Still here
styles: slow slide guitar melody that finally comes home to D
